title: 第14章 你口味真独特
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

赵楹月头顶三个大问号。

“风太大，你说什么，我没听清。”

“搬砖，养你。”

她没有刻意将手机的音量调低，旁边的宁南听得清清楚楚。

甚至还贴心的重复一遍：“老大，秦三说他要搬砖养你。”

赵楹月瞪宁南，示意他闭嘴。

然后才咬牙说：“谁让你三十五度的天去搬砖的？”

看着挺精明一人，怎么如此愚蠢！

海市现在每天的平均温度都在三十五摄氏度往上。

部分外空行业都放了高温假。

真要顶着这么炎热的天气去搬砖，不用一天，半天就能中暑。

到底是哪个黑心老板，居然让人在太阳正毒的时候去搬砖！

赵楹月心头腾的一下升起一团火。

下一秒。

秦渡：“你凶我？”

赵楹月：“……这不是重点。”

她深呼吸了一口气，“你现在马上立刻回来。”

秦渡：“不。”

说完，竟直接将电话挂断了。

等赵楹月再拨过去时，已经无人接听。

死一般的寂静。

赵楹月攥紧手机，唇角勾勒出一抹邪魅狷狂的笑。

男人，你成功引起了我的兴趣！

宁南看着这抹熟悉的笑容，缩着脖子打了个寒颤。

以往赵楹月这样一笑，就有人要倒大霉了。

“老大，你可悠着点，”宁南小心的提醒她，“要是村长知道你在外面胡作非为，一定会连夜坐绿皮火车让你知道花儿为什么这么红。”

赵楹月敷衍了一句，下一秒就打车离开了网吧。

太阳火辣辣的炙烤着整座城市。

路上鲜少会见外出的路人，大多都缩在室内，连门都不敢出。

华铁工地施工区内。

秦渡穿着被汗水湿透的背心，顶着烈日在搬着砖。

他一声不吭，饶是被砖头划破了掌心，也没见叫疼一下。

站在阴凉处监督他的人，见此，扬声嚎了一嗓子：“兄弟，加油干啊，回头我多给你二十补贴！”

秦渡垂眼，没应。

Page (1/3)

Zhao Yingyue had three big question marks above her head.

"The wind was too strong. I didn't hear what you said clearly."

"Moving bricks to support you."

She didn't deliberately turn down the volume on her phone, and Ning Nan next to her could hear her clearly.

He even repeated it thoughtfully: "Boss, Qin San said he would raise bricks to support you."

Zhao Yingyue glared at Ning Nan and told him to shut up.

Then he gritted his teeth and said, "Who asked you to move bricks on a 35-degree day?"

He seems to be a very smart person, but how can he be so stupid!

The average daily temperature in Haishi is now above 35 degrees Celsius.

Some outer space industries have taken a high temperature holiday.

If you really have to carry bricks in such hot weather, you will suffer from heatstroke in less than a day, but in half a day.

What kind of evil boss actually lets people move bricks when the sun is shining!

Zhao Yingyue felt a fire rising in her heart.

The next second.

Qin Du: "Are you cruel to me?"

Zhao Yingyue: "...This is not the point."

She took a deep breath and said, "Come back right now."

Qin Du: "No."

After saying that, he hung up the phone directly.

When Zhao Yingyue called again, no one answered.

Deathly silence.

Zhao Yingyue clenched her phone tightly, with a wicked and savage smile on her lips.

Man, you managed to pique my interest!

Looking at this familiar smile, Ning Nan shrank his neck and shuddered.

In the past, when Zhao Yingyue smiled like this, someone would be in bad luck.

"Boss, please take it easy," Ning Nan reminded her carefully. "If the village chief knew that you were causing mischief outside, he would definitely take the green leather train overnight to let you know why the flowers are so red."

Zhao Yingyue said something perfunctory and took a taxi to leave the Internet cafe the next second.

The sun was scorching the whole city.

It is rare to see passers-by going out on the road. Most of them are huddled indoors, not even daring to go out.

In the construction area of ​​Huatie construction site.

Qin Du was wearing a vest soaked with sweat and carrying bricks under the scorching sun.

He didn't say a word, even though his palm was scratched by a brick, he didn't even cry out in pain.

When the person who was standing in the shade supervising him saw this, he raised his voice and howled: "Brother, keep going, I'll give you an extra twenty subsidy later!"

Qin Du lowered his eyes and didn't respond.
